My dear Madam
That poem on the Sabbath Bells was given me by Lady [Lucy Herbert](../persons.html#679), [ Lord Powis](../persons.html#2076)’s sister, at the time when she was collecting subscriptions for [bells for Auckland](../others.html#103) Cathedral New Zealand.

She sent it to me undoubtingly to be printed with an appeal we were then making.

She has since married and I cannot remember her present name - but perhaps you know her, and at any rate her sister, Lady [Harriet Herbert](../persons.html#680) would, I am sure, be glad to tell you how the verses came into their family[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: William Wordsworth, Ecclesiastical Sonnets, 28, begins: \'The Sabbath bells renew the inviting peal\', and may be the poem referred to.
